title: SKILL FIRST · GUARD ANGLE CONTROL
emphasis: Carry forward yesterday’s planned guard-to-angle sequence; no advancement is assumed. Build controlled sticky-feet connection, find the butterfly-half angle, and reset cleanly.

ignition.name: Moving Guard Prep
ignition.prescription: 2 min hip-escape-to-seated resets, 2 min sticky-foot pummeling into butterfly-half position, then 1 min slow arm-drag reaches with a balanced reset. Demo unavailable.
ignition.home: 2 min hip-escape-to-seated resets, 2 min sticky-foot pummeling into butterfly-half position, then 1 min slow arm-drag reaches with a balanced reset. Demo unavailable.
ignition.away: Use the same moving sequence on a mat; keep every position comfortable.
ignition.cue: Finish each transition balanced before repeating.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: SKILL · CONNECT AND FIND THE ANGLE
deposits.effort: 3 controlled reps per side. The 25-sec side windows pace the reps; they are not AMRAP.

exercises.name: Sticky Feet → Butterfly Half → Arm Drag
exercises.prescription: Complete 3 controlled reps per side with a grappling dummy, fully resetting after each rep. Unbanded is the default. If already familiar with the Dopa Arm Drag setup, light assistance is optional and must not change the movement path. Brand drill: https://dopamineo.com/arm-drag-drill-elbow-from-beneath/
exercises.home: Complete 3 controlled reps per side with a grappling dummy, fully resetting after each rep. Unbanded is the default. If already familiar with the Dopa Arm Drag setup, light assistance is optional and must not change the movement path. Brand drill: https://dopamineo.com/arm-drag-drill-elbow-from-beneath/
exercises.away: Shadow the same positions slowly on a mat: sticky contact, butterfly-half angle, arm-drag reach, balanced reset.
exercises.cue: Keep sticky foot contact while your hands create the angle.

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: STRENGTH · PULL, FRAME, STAY TALL
deposits.effort: Quality strength only. Stop with 2–3 clean reps in reserve; use the clock as a pacing window, never AMRAP.

exercises.name: Ring Row
exercises.cue: Pull to the ribs without losing your base.
exercises.prescription: 6–8 clean ring rows. The 45-sec window is pacing only, not a rep target. Keep the trunk square to support the arm-drag pull without twisting.
exercises.home: 6–8 clean ring rows. The 45-sec window is pacing only, not a rep target. Keep the trunk square to support the arm-drag pull without twisting.
exercises.away: Use a light standing cable row for 6–8 clean reps.

exercises.name: Ring Push-Up
exercises.cue: Make one solid line from shoulders through hips.
exercises.prescription: 6–8 controlled ring push-ups. The 45-sec window is pacing only, not a rep target. Hold a strong trunk and shoulder position to support stable frames and posts.
exercises.home: 6–8 controlled ring push-ups. The 45-sec window is pacing only, not a rep target. Hold a strong trunk and shoulder position to support stable frames and posts.
exercises.away: Use an elevated push-up for 6–8 controlled reps.

exercises.name: Double Kettlebell Front-Rack Carry
exercises.cue: Stay tall so the load cannot fold your posture.
exercises.prescription: Walk for 60 sec with manageable kettlebells in the front rack. This is timed posture work, not counted reps. Keep breathing and stop before posture degrades.
exercises.home: Walk for 60 sec with manageable kettlebells in the front rack. This is timed posture work, not counted reps. Keep breathing and stop before posture degrades.
exercises.away: Use two manageable dumbbells or perform a light front-rack march in place.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: ROUNDS · KEEP CONNECTION UNDER MOVEMENT
deposits.effort: 2:30 easy technical movement, then 1:00 full reset. Technique must look like the fresh practice.

exercises.name: Butterfly-Half Connection Round
exercises.prescription: Flow safely with a dummy: establish sticky feet, enter butterfly half, find the arm-drag angle, settle, and reset. Pause whenever connection or balance breaks. No hard submission finishing. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Flow safely with a dummy: establish sticky feet, enter butterfly half, find the arm-drag angle, settle, and reset. Pause whenever connection or balance breaks. No hard submission finishing. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Shadow the same guard transitions on a mat at an easy technical pace.
exercises.cue: Connection first; the arm drag comes after the angle.

levels.floor: 10:00 · 2 min moving guard prep + 5 min controlled skill (3/side with resets) + 3 min support: 1×6 ring rows, 1×30-sec front-rack march, setup/reset
levels.standard: 38:40 · includes setup, side switches and rest

weekSummary: Moving prep → guard skill → strength that supports it → repeat the same skill in rounds

martialSupplement.name: SKILL PRACTICE IS IN THE WORKOUT
martialSupplement.text: No separate dummy lab today—the mandatory guard skill is included in the workout above.
